_doc: STAGING. Sunday Dinner is sunday and kitchen merged — the kitchen list was refused by the cultural bench as a culinary-school verb drawer that never said WHOSE kitchen, and joined to the table it exists for, it stops being a technique list. Apart: 8 and 6 boards. Together: 32. Their re-listing is what carries it — pot liquor, the grease can, seasoning by eye.

theme.name: Sunday Dinner
theme.blurb: The pot that went on before church, the plate fixed for somebody who could not come, and the seat nobody else sits in.

boards.scene: The plate, and who it is being made for

clues.planet: The size of the plate, which is why nobody eats again until Tuesday
clues.plate: Fixed and covered in foil for somebody who could not come, before anyone sits
clues.late: You are, and something is already covered in foil on the stove for you
clues.nap: What happens at four, in the chair, mid-sentence, and nobody comments
clues.tea: Poured over ice into the glass that is only used today
clues.pane: The kitchen window, steamed over since noon, and the sound behind it

boards.scene: The pot that needs watching, and the spoon that gets handed over

clues.satire: The tone taken about anything instant, by a woman who has never bought it
clues.stir: Constantly, and handing the spoon over is a small ceremony
clues.rest: Off the heat with the lid on, which is where they actually finish
clues.sear: The salmon croquettes in the same pan, and the fond is the point
clues.tears: From the onion, and from being handed the spoon, and both get denied
clues.tea: In the jug by eleven, because it needs those three hours to get properly cold

boards.scene: The oven door, and the things kept behind it

clues.warmth: What the lowest setting is for, and it holds four dishes at once
clues.ham: In there since one, foil tented, waiting for everything slower than it
clues.warm: Not hot. The distinction is the entire skill and it is never explained
clues.thaw: Started Friday night, in the fridge, because Sunday was always the plan
clues.hat: Still on, because she came straight from church and has not sat down
clues.wham: The oven door, closed with a hip, both hands full

boards.scene: Who is allowed in the kitchen

clues.aprons: There are two, and only one of them has ever been offered to a guest
clues.apron: Over the good dress, tied at the back by somebody else, still buttoned
clues.nap: What the man on the couch is taking during all of this, unbothered
clues.sop: What the bread is for, and doing it is the compliment
clues.span: Of the counter she works in, about four feet, and stepping into it is a mistake
clues.soar: What the smoke alarm does at some point, and it is ignored

boards.scene: The cake, made the night before

clues.backed: What the whole afternoon is, by something that happened at eleven last night
clues.cake: Pound, from a recipe on a card in handwriting nobody living can read
clues.bake: Started at nine at night, because the oven was busy until then
clues.dab: Of the batter on a finger, which is the whole reason to be in there
clues.deck: The counter, cleared entirely, which happens exactly once a week
clues.back: Of the recipe card, where the instructions that matter were added later

boards.scene: The greens, and the pot liquor

clues.tigers: What the pot is guarded like, from about noon onward
clues.grits: Not today. Today the pot is doing something else entirely
clues.stir: Once an hour, and the smell is the thing that fills the house
clues.rest: What the greens do best of all, and Monday's are better than today's
clues.tries: How many times someone lifts the lid, and each one is noticed
clues.tires: What she insists she never does, while refusing every offer of a chair
